CAPTURED FROM OUR OWN CODE, NOT FROM ANY VENDOR. No odds feed data is here.

feed_off_golden.json
  What bucketlib/props_ui.py rendered BEFORE the licensed odds feed reached
  it (build 2's tree, stage S8's starting point, 2026-11-10), for the
  hand-built rows of tests/ui_rows.py: invented players and numbers on the
  serve fixture's 2026-03-12 date.
    "functions"  ui_rows.feed_off_outputs(props_ui): the ledger, the Game
                 page's line rows (before and after tip), the notes, the
                 board's title bar, the none-matched notice, the
                 discrepancy title, strip and table, every stat cell, the
                 paste time, the two no-lines prompts and PROPS_CSS.
    "page"       the markdown, success and caption elements of a Streamlit
                 page (AppTest) running render_board, render_discrepancies
                 and render_player_lines_block on those rows.
  tests/test_props_ui_feed.py checks that props_ui with the feed off (no
  feed argument, or feed=None) still renders exactly this, byte for byte:
  with no key configured the site must keep today's HTML on every page.
  Written with json's ASCII escapes, so the sentinel shows as \u2014 here.
  NEVER regenerate it from the current code to make a test pass: a change to
  the feed-off HTML is a change to the live site and needs its own decision.
